invented: Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer sit in the lab test-execution and validation-measurement part of the workflow
The signal generator is the RF stimulus source connected to the DUT
The analyzer is the RF measurement receiver connected to the DUT output or emission port
output power, frequency error, modulation quality/EVM, time alignment error, occupied bandwidth, ACLR, SEM/OBUE, spurious emissions, and transmitter intermodulation
